spans.s: The Indian crane; न प्रयत्नशतेनापि शुकवत् पाठ्यते बकः H.

A cheat, rogue, hypocrite (the crane being a very cunning bird that
 knows well how to draw others into its clutches).
N. of a demon killed by Bhīma.
N. of another demon killed by Kṛṣṇa.
An apparatus for subliming metals or minerals.

A female crane.

+ -पञ्चकम् the last five days of the bright half of the month of
 Kārtika (during which even the heron eats no fish).
Denom. P. To act like बक.
A wind instrument used in battle; अभि दस्युं बकुरेणा धमन्ता

A kind of tree, Mimusops Elengi, (said according to the convention
 of poets to put forth blossoms when sprinkled by young women with mouthfuls
 of wine); काङ्क्षत्यन्यो (केसरः or बकुलः) वदनमादिरां
 दोहदच्छद्यनाऽस्याः

; बकुलः सीधुगण्डूषसेकात् (विकसति);
 तव निश्वसितानुकारिर्भिर्बकुलैरर्धचितां समं मया
